maya: Quick sync — runtime perf roadmap for Q2. Key asks: kernel selection improvements, quantization pipeline w/ end-to-end evals, KV cache consistency fixes, and throughput SLOs for Dedicated customers. Need prioritization + launch criteria.
sam (Eng-RT): +1. My vote: kernel selection + KV cache first. They unblock most latency variance.
jorge (ML): quantization work affects memory & throughput a lot. We should split into two slices: quantization infra (tooling, aware of per-op errors) and model-specific QA (evals for quality drift).
liam (SRE): FYI customers reported tail latency spikes during bursts — likely batching + cache eviction behavior. Can we define an SLO target? e.g., p95 < 120ms for 512 seq on v2 instances?
maya: Good point. Proposed OKR: Reduce tail latency for hosted API p95 by 30% and cut per-token cost by 15% for interactive workloads. Launch criteria: perf regression tests + canary with real traffic, plus rollback plan.
sam (Eng-RT): For kernels: schedule work to add auto-kernel-selection: heuristic picks based on seq_len distribution. Dev plan: 2-week spike to prototype, 4 weeks to integrate. Risk: increased binary complexity.
jorge (ML): Quantization plan: first pass LLM-aware static quant (8-bit), add simulated evals. Acceptance: <2% BLEU-like drop on our eval prompts + no hallucination regressions on safety tests.
maya: Customer asks: Enterprise A wants deterministic KV cache across replicas (for RBAC usecases). Scoped request: guarantee cache consistency for Dedicated within same AZ. Cost: medium-high. Can this be in Q2?
sam (Eng-RT): We can do eventual consistency now, strong consistency would require KV invalidation protocol and maybe cross-replica locking — estimate 6-8 weeks. Suggest MVP: per-node warm KV + deterministic fallback policy for read-after-write within 100ms window.
liam (SRE): Also need observability: token-level traces, cache hit/miss histograms, and queue length metrics before GA.
maya: Prioritization vote: 1) kernel selection + auto-kernel, 2) KV cache determinism MVP + metrics, 3) quantization infra + evals, 4) regression harness improvements. Thoughts?
jorge (ML): Agree but prefer quantization up earlier if we have a big customer using quantized model.
sam (Eng-RT): OK with ordering. I'll draft a spec with deliverables, timelines, and rollback hooks. Will call out needed infra changes and perf tests.
ops-bot: Deployments scheduled: spike branches permitted in dev only. Please file RFC before merging.
maya: Thanks — aim to have the RFC and a 2-week plan by Fri. I'll sync with sales on Enterprise A timelines. :thumbsup:
